subject: [PATCH 06/60] mm/memory_hotplug: migrate offlined pages to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a limitation in the current code where migration is restricted to N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes. Proposed modifying the hot-unplug migration target-list to reflect only eligible allocation targets.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to migrate offlined pages to common memory, addressing a limitation in the current code where migration is restricted to N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes. The proposed change involves modifying the hot-unplug migration target-list to reflect only eligible allocation targets.
